GENESIS v0.97 - how to get the site back from the 7 parts
Download ALL 7 files (Genesis-v0.97-DEPLOY-www.zip.000 to .006) into ONE folder.

Mac/Linux:   cat Genesis-v0.97-DEPLOY-www.zip.0* > Genesis-v0.97-DEPLOY-www.zip
Windows cmd: copy /b Genesis-v0.97-DEPLOY-www.zip.000+Genesis-v0.97-DEPLOY-www.zip.001+Genesis-v0.97-DEPLOY-www.zip.002+Genesis-v0.97-DEPLOY-www.zip.003+Genesis-v0.97-DEPLOY-www.zip.004+Genesis-v0.97-DEPLOY-www.zip.005+Genesis-v0.97-DEPLOY-www.zip.006 Genesis-v0.97-DEPLOY-www.zip
Check (optional): sha256sum -c JOIN_CHECK.sha256   (Windows: certutil -hashfile Genesis-v0.97-DEPLOY-www.zip SHA256)

Then unzip Genesis-v0.97-DEPLOY-www.zip into a folder. That folder IS the website: deploy it (DEPLOY-README.txt inside).

Genesis-v0.97-SOURCE.zip = source, tests, tools, docs WITHOUT the big model/vendor files. Those are inside the site zip (models/, vendor/):
copy them into the source tree's models/ and vendor/ if you want to rebuild.
